entities.summary: Martynivka Treasure is a hoard consisting of 116 silver items found in 1909, in the village of Martynivka, Cherkasy Oblast, Ukraine. The treasure is currently preserved at the National Historical Museum of Ukraine in Kyiv and the British Museum in London. It is dated approximately to the 6th–7th centuries AD.
